title: Derived scalar extension of a closed supported constant sheaf
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $i:D\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], let $N\geq1$ be an integer, put $\Lambda=(\mathbf Z/N\mathbf Z)$, and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$. In the ordinary small etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the canonical comparison, adjoint to the coefficient unit $\Lambda_D\to A_D$, for the derived change-of-rings functor [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] along $\Lambda_T\to A_T$ identifies $Ri_*\Lambda_D\otimes_{\Lambda_T}^{\mathbf L}A_T$ with $Ri_*A_D$, where direct image is [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], inverse image and constant sheaves are as in [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and derived tensor is [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Under this identification the map induced from $\Lambda_T\to i_*\Lambda_D$ is the unit $A_T\to Ri_*A_D$. The identification is valid without flatness of $A$ over $\Lambda$.

source.place: Tag 03QP, proposition-finite-higher-direct-image-zero, together with Tag 03Q1, lemma-stalk-pullback, and sites-cohomology derived change of rings
